title: Polar animals
examples: What do polar bears eat in the cold?
How do penguins survive the cold water?

explain.say: Today we learn about animals that live in the very cold north.
Polar bears have very thick layers of fat under their skin.
Penguins are birds that cannot fly but swim very well.
Seals have smooth skin and often live near the icy edges.
Arctic foxes change their coat color to hide in the snow.
These animals use fat, fur, and special swimming bodies to stay warm.

faq.q: Do polar bears have fur that is white?
faq.a: Their fur can look white, but it is actually clear and translucent. It reflects the light to look white.
asks: Is polar bear fur really white?
What color is a polar bear's fur?

faq.q: How do penguins keep their bodies warm in the cold water?
faq.a: They have a layer of fat and special feathers that help them stay warm while swimming. Their feathers trap air.
asks: Do penguins get cold in the ocean?
What keeps penguins warm when swimming?

faq.q: Do all animals in the Arctic look white?
faq.a: No, some animals like the foxes change colors to match their surroundings. This is called camouflage.
asks: How do animals hide in the snow?

faq.q: What is blubber and why do animals need it?
faq.a: Blubber is a thick layer of fat under the skin. It acts like a built-in coat to keep the animal warm.
asks: What is the fat layer under a seal?
Why do animals have thick fat?

faq.q: Do seals have fur like bears?
faq.a: Seals have smooth skin covered by a layer of fat, not thick fur like a bear. Their skin is very waterproof.

facts: Polar bears use blubber for insulation against the cold.
Penguins use their wings like flippers to swim.
Arctic foxes change their coat color for camouflage.
The cold environment requires thick layers for survival.

quiz.say: Which animal uses blubber primarily for warmth?
quiz.why: Polar bears have a thick layer of fat called blubber that keeps them warm in the cold.

wrong.1: Penguins use specialized feathers and fat layers, but blubber is most famous for bears.
wrong.2: Seals have fat, but the term blubber is most strongly associated with polar bears.
wrong.3: Foxes rely more on thick fur and changing coats than a thick blubber layer.

quiz.say: What helps the Arctic fox blend into the snow?
quiz.why: The fox changes its fur color to match the snow or ground, which is called camouflage.

wrong.0: Teeth help with eating, but they do not help an animal hide.
wrong.2: Blubber helps with warmth, not with hiding from predators.
wrong.3: Flippers help with swimming, not with changing color.

quiz.say: What is the main way penguins swim?
quiz.why: Penguins cannot fly in the air, so they use their strong wings like flippers in the water.

wrong.1: They do not have fins like fish; they use their modified wings.
wrong.2: Walking is slow; they are built for powerful swimming movements.
wrong.3: While they move their body, their specialized wings provide the main propulsion.
